rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Lollypop
rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm Kordes III (1953 - 2016) (Germany, before 1999).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Wholesale) in 2000 as 'Lollypop'.
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in before 2021 as 'Lolly Pop'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very double, borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or exhibition.
